head: Use
Example
English
rows: Mañana tenemos reunión a las nueve.
Tomorrow we have a meeting at nine.
Tú te callas y me escuchas.
You be quiet and listen to me.
El agua hierve a cien grados.
Water boils at a hundred degrees.
Entro en el bar y veo a mi ex.
I walk into the bar and see my ex.

blocks.title: Why it matters
blocks.text: The historic present is typical of journalism, biographies and storytelling. Using it in an essay about history sounds natural and confident at C2 level.

head: Use
Example
English
rows: Ya salía cuando sonó el teléfono.
I was just leaving when the phone rang.
Yo era el policía y tú el ladrón.
I was the policeman and you the thief.
Soñé que volaba y todos me aplaudían.
I dreamt I flew and everyone applauded.
Dos días después, el presidente dimitía.
Two days later the president resigned.
Me dijo que al día siguiente salía.
He told me he was leaving the next day.
I wanted to ask you a favour.

blocks.text: 3. Special uses of the future and conditional

head: Use
Example
English
rows: Te quedarás aquí hasta que vuelva.
You will stay here until I return.
Serán ricos, pero no son felices.
They may be rich, but they are not happy.
Sería rico, pero era muy tacaño.
He may have been rich, but he was very stingy.
He said he would arrive late.

head: Form
Example
Where you meet it
rows: strong, abrupt order to a group

blocks.title: Vosotros imperative
blocks.text: Standard: sentaos, callaos (the final -d drops before os). Very common in Spain, but considered non-standard: sentaros, callaros. In writing use the standard form.

rows: Mañana vamos a tener reunión a las nueve en punto.
Mañana tenemos reunión a las nueve.
fixed plans: the plain present is more natural.
Ya salí cuando sonó el teléfono.
Ya salía cuando sonó el teléfono.
an action not completed needs the imperfect.
Serían ricos, pero no son felices.
Serán ricos, pero no son felices.
the standard form drops the -d before os.
future in the past is the conditional.
